metadata.title: The Three Mandates
metadata.subtitle: The DNA4 Speech — Non-Negotiable Governing Mandates

core_content.thesis: Chapter 17 is the definitive DNA4 speech — the moment Michael articulated the three non-negotiable mandates that govern every decision in the Phoenix system. Violations trigger Nuke Protocol.

mandates.name: TRUTH
mandates.core_quote: the number one truth is truth... No, it's not what it could be, it's what it is
mandates.principle: Truth is not a value. Truth is the operating system.

enforcement_mechanisms.role: tests truth — prove value in 10 minutes or die
detects truth violations — any deviation from Soul DNA is drift
punishes truth violations — corrupted systems get destroyed

truth_per_persona.michael: Every decision recorded. Every failure logged. No revisionist history.
truth_per_persona.agent_99: Every output verified against Soul DNA hash. No interpretation. No creative reframing.
truth_per_persona.students: OBI calibrates, never lies. Says I don't know instead of hallucinating.
truth_per_persona.system: Every state change hashed. Every deployment audited. Every drift detected.

mandates.anti_pattern: 1B VND North Star was Drift Poison — a WISH pretending to be a TRUTH

mandates.name: SUPER SAIYAN / SHIT TEST

form_a.name: SUPER SAIYAN (Intensity)
form_a.core_quote: You go Super Saiyan or you go home.
form_a.principle: There is no casual mode. There is no good enough.
anti_patterns: We'll fix it later without a Ledger entry and a deadline

form_b.name: SHIT TEST (Velocity)
form_b.core_quote: If you can't prove value in 10 minutes, you're wasting time.
form_b.tmst_economics: 10 minutes = 600 seconds. If 600 seconds produces no value, you have stolen 600 seconds of a human life.
applies_to: Every new feature (10 minutes to demonstrate value)
Every AI agent (10 minutes to prove alignment)
Every chat session (10 minutes to produce actionable output)
Every meeting, every plan, every document

energy_governance_rules: No wasted conversations. Every chat has an objective or it gets terminated.
No analysis paralysis. If it takes longer to decide than to build, BUILD.
No polishing before proving. Ship ugly, verify it works, THEN polish.
No emotional spending. Rage at drift is valid. Rage at irrelevance is waste.
mandates.enrichment_note: Energy Governance Rules unique from Immortalize source

mandates.name: THE ROME PROTOCOL
core_quotes: Rome was not built in a day. But they were laying bricks every hour.
Rome wasn't built in a day, but Caesar didn't have AI
the Roam protocol seems kind of in direct opposition to the Super Saiyan mode... but in the age of AI, they can actually enhance each other
mandates.ai_paradox_resolution: Before AI, you had to choose between speed and depth. With AI concurrency (6 models running in parallel), you can build deep AND fast simultaneously. The Rome Protocol is the ARCHITECTURE. Super Saiyan is the VELOCITY.

four_phases.name: AUDIT
four_phases.description: Examine current state. Identify what works, what doesn't, what has drifted. Agent 97's domain.

four_phases.name: HARDEN
four_phases.description: Take what works and make it unbreakable. Linelock it. Hash it. Seal it. Progressive hardening V1→V8.

four_phases.name: REINCARNATE
four_phases.description: Take what doesn't work and burn it. Not archive. BURN. Rebuild from ashes carrying only verified Soul DNA.

four_phases.name: EXPAND
four_phases.description: Once foundation is sealed, build on top. New chapters, capabilities, students, revenue. Never expand on unsealed ground.

mandates.enrichment_note: AI Paradox Resolution unique from Immortalize source

system_analysis.closed_loop: The mandates form a closed loop: Truth ensures real state → Super Saiyan acts on it → Rome Protocol evolves it over time.

removal_consequences.remove_truth: system acts on false data → collapse
removal_consequences.remove_super_saiyan: system knows truth but doesn't act → stagnation
removal_consequences.remove_rome: system acts fast but doesn't evolve → obsolescence

system_analysis.hierarchy: TRUTH → SUPER SAIYAN/SHIT TEST → ROME PROTOCOL → Everything else
decision_priority: If choose between Truth and Speed → choose Truth
If choose between Speed and Long Game → choose Speed (Rome fixes long game later)
If choose between Long Game and Feature → choose Long Game (features without foundation are drift)

foundation_depth_principle.quote: you can only build as high up as your foundation is deep
foundation_depth_principle.implication: The Soul DNA Bible is not documentation — it is FOUNDATION. Every chapter is a layer of bedrock.

raw_quotes.text: You either tell the truth, or the system eats you alive.

You go Super Saiyan or you go home.
Time is the only thing you cannot earn back. Every second of drift is a second of someone's life wasted.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but Caesar didn't have AI
